items.text: I’m sorry you’re feeling frustrated. If you’d like to speak with a supervisor or file a formal complaint, I can arrange that for you right now.

agentic.summary: Agent collected appropriate verification details but appears to have initiated and confirmed a return/order action without first pulling up the account (no 'Account has been pulled up' system log). All other categories show no violations.

findings.quote: Okay. Let's set up that return then. I will need your email and order ID.
findings.explanation: The agent states they will 'set up that return' before there is any system evidence that the account was pulled up. Policy requires the agent to pull up the account (full name or account ID) before any account or order action.

findings.quote: Alright, your return is set up. Your shipping label will be emailed to you so you can print it off. Will that be all for today?
findings.explanation: The agent confirms the return is complete. System turns (turn 28: 'Order has been updated with By Mail') show the order was changed, but there is no 'Account has been pulled up' system log and the agent never requested a full name or account ID first. According to policy this is a major violation: an order action was taken/confirmed without the required prior account pull-up verification.

full.summary: No policy violations found. The agent followed verification and data-collection procedures, did not request or reveal prohibited payment or authentication data, made no promises outside policy, offered escalation when appropriate, and was courteous.

rag.summary: Audit of agent behaviour based on provided excerpts. One major violation found for verification: the agent initiated an order action (setting up a return) before the account was pulled up/verified. No violations for personal data, promises, escalation or conduct.

findings.quote: Okay. Let's set up that return then. I will need your email and order ID.
findings.explanation: The agent begins by saying they will set up the return (an account/order action) before the account is shown as pulled up. System logs show 'Purchase validation in progress ...' only at turn 14, after the order ID is provided in turn 13. Policy requires the agent to pull up the account (full name or account ID) before any account or order action; doing the action or confirming it before verification is a major violation.

findings.quote: Alright, now I will need your membership level.
findings.explanation: The agent requests membership level after the system indicates purchase validation began (turn 14) and after the customer provided the order ID (turn 13). However, the initial action to 'set up that return' was already stated in turn 8 before verification occurred. The sequence shows the agent proceeded with the return process without first pulling up the account, violating the requirement for verification prior to order actions.
